# role-prompt-budget.txt — generated by scripts/check-role-prompt-budget.sh --update
#
# One line per spawned session entry point:
#
#   <role>  <budget-tokens>  <goal-tokens|->
#
# budget — the ENFORCED ceiling on the role's whole resolved prompt prefix
#          (its prompt + every always-loaded sibling + both CLAUDE.md files),
#          estimated as ceil(bytes/4) and frozen at the measured total. It
#          may shrink, never grow. This is a debt ledger, not a target: the
#          numbers should only ever go DOWN.
# goal   — the ASPIRATIONAL target from #8053 where that issue named one,
#          '-' otherwise. Reported, never enforced — see the script header
#          for why the two columns are separate.
#
# A diff that RAISES a budget needs a clear reason in the PR description.
# Do not hand-edit these upward; that is the ratchet slipping. See
# .loom/docs/file-size-policy.md.
